verdict.rationale: Clara's public API documents creating, updating, locking/unlocking and deleting cards (clara-docs-11), including virtual cards that are active immediately (clara-docs-10). A Card Configurations API adds time, day-of-week and merchant-category controls (clara-docs-15), plus period-based auto-deletion (clara-docs-16), and a live OpenAPI schema backs this up (clara-probe-3). Missing for 10: an explicit mention of setting a spending limit at card creation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the card-issuing endpoints.
